newsitem.title: USA: Bergen Cty, N.J., okays $22 mln in bonds -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Bergen Cty, N.J., okays $22 mln in bonds -- paper.

text.p: The Bergen County, N.J., Board of Freeholders adopted two bond ordinances totaling $22 million for improvements to county bridges and roads, the Bergen Record reported Tuesday.
Among the biggest projects is a $5 million to $6 million plan to widen the Midland Avenue bridge over the Garden State Parkway in Saddle Brook.
A total of 52 separate projects are included in the plan, the newspaper said.
